title: Data Loading — Portable Data Loader Interface — Replacement of the Extended Temperature Transceiver

ata.title: Data Loading — Portable Data Loader Interface

abstract: Cancelled bulletin that replaced the data loader interface transceiver to remove the high ambient temperature load abort. It is superseded by the standard B conversion, which contains the same change and more.

sections.planning_reason: Software loading through the portable data loader interface aborted whenever the avionics bay rose above about forty-five degrees, which on a parked aircraft in a warm climate happens within an hour. A failed load leaves the target computer in an indeterminate state and has to be repeated from the beginning. Fifty-one aborted loads were reported in the 2016 season across thirty-eight aircraft and two of them ended with the target computer replaced.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin replaced the interface transceiver with an item of the same form and fit built with an extended temperature range line driver and a revised clock recovery stage. The unit is a line replaceable item and the aircraft installation is unchanged. The rack cooling path was checked and the blanking plate above the unit refitted, because several reported aborts were traced to a missing plate diverting the cooling flow.
sections.accomplishment_summary: De-power the avionics rack and confirm that no load is in progress. Get access to the avionics bay in zone 252. Remove the transceiver from the rack position at FIN 78TN. Check that the blanking plate above the unit is present and correctly seated, and fit one if it is missing. Install the transceiver D4545112932616 of the new build standard and secure it in the rack. Restore power and do a test load to a non-critical target following task AMM-Z-45-45-11-900-026-A. Confirm that the load completes and record the embodiment. The rack arrangement is shown on drawing D45451170573.
sections.effectivity_note: Was applicable to aircraft in the MSN Z02022 to Z07470 range not yet at the standard B data loader interface. Aircraft converted to standard B carry the extended temperature transceiver as part of that conversion.
sections.material_note: Kit K4545-1010-01 contained one transceiver and one blanking plate. The kit is withdrawn. Operators who have not embodied this bulletin should embody the standard B conversion instead.

type_data.compliance_time: Cancelled. Operators are directed to the standard B conversion bulletin, which contains this change.

revision_history.reason: Bulletin cancelled and superseded by the standard B conversion
